description: List the values the site browses its recipes by. The taxonomies are dieta, edad, ingrediente, ocasion, recetas-de, tecnica, tipo-de-cocina, tipo-plato: diet, the age of whoever eats it, main ingredient, occasion, moment of the day, appliance, cuisine and kind of dish. Call this before browse_recipes rather than spelling a value yourself. Pass 'facet' for one taxonomy, or leave it out for all eight, which costs one request per taxonomy.

facet.description: One taxonomy: dieta, edad, ingrediente, ocasion, recetas-de, tecnica, tipo-de-cocina, tipo-plato. All eight when left out.
